implementation: Four global stages replace a row-resident CTA. Eight independent K32 waves per CTA emit tile maxima; a256-thread row scan forms identical prefix maxima; independent K32 waves compute original EXP probabilities, butterfly sums and alphas; one thread per row folds tile-major coefficients in the original FP32 order. Only maximum scans are reassociated, as in the existing staged control. Width<=8192, queries<=128 and exact start+query stride plus workspace capacity/pointer validation bound launches. No runtime dispatcher includes the new header.
correctness_scope: Safety covers ten causal shapes through8192, six score families, both K32 reduction orders and both table/native EXP behavior. All raw P/scales/denominators match the original one-wave kernel, with constant-score CPU checks, workspace alpha equality, shape/capacity rejection, immutable inputs and guards/tails. Captures use unchanged current prepared QK, original one-wave/staged/split probabilities and unchanged native plus compact original PV replay. Every warmup/timed attempt compares all raw scores, probabilities, scales, context outputs, accumulators, denominators and error bounds plus original candidate counts against an independent original tiled QK pipeline. Candidate index order is not a bytewise invariant. All29364224 original7169 GB10 context cells match; q8192 repeats1023 captured Q/K/V rows and compares all33554432 outputs to original arithmetic. Golden data never enters computation. Probability workspace active values, alpha copies, monotonic prefixes, guards and causal/unused tails are checked.
timing_scope: One warmup and three rotated complete host samples per128-query slab, including QK, every probability phase and dispatch, native PV, collection and selected original replay. Common QK preparation and V transpose are measured once and included separately. Allocations, reset, comparisons and immutable-input observers are outside clocks. GPU probability events are diagnostic; invalid intervals, if any, are retained in stderr and counted, not accepted as timing. No model load, token loop or TTFT was measured.
